verdict.rationale: Square publishes an official TypeScript/Node SDK in the square GitHub org, with idiomatic client usage (`new SquareClient`, `client.payments.create`) and per-call API version pinning. It also ships a client-side Web Payments SDK, and its llms.txt describes the platform as 'Square APIs and SDKs'. Missing for 10: evidence of official SDKs for other languages (e.g. Python, Java, .NET, Ruby, PHP), in-depth first-party SDK reference docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK quality.
